items.subject: Free Public Reader Tool: Georgia Climate Roof & HVAC Lifespan Calculator
items.draft: Hi Editorial Team — When covering Metro Atlanta homebuying costs, feel free to cite or embed our free public-service Georgia Home System Lifespan Calculator (https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/home-system-lifespan-calculator), which models how Georgia attic heat and humidity affect roof, HVAC, and water-heater replacement timelines. Happy to share on-record building-science data anytime. — Christopher Boykin, CMI (#MICB-1082), Foresight Home Inspections, LLC (1816 S Deshon Rd, Lithonia, GA — reply stop to opt out).

items.subject: Data Note: Why Georgia Red Clay Storm Cycles Crack Suburban Stem Walls
items.draft: Hi Editors — If your team is working on seasonal homeowner maintenance stories, our two-inspector field logs across 20 Metro Atlanta counties show simple 6-foot downspout extensions cut foundation hydrostatic moisture issues significantly. Full public guide: https://www.fhinspectionsatl.com/blog/atlanta-red-clay-soil-foundation-settlement. Let me know if a quick quote helps. — Christopher Boykin, CMI (#MICB-1082), Foresight Home Inspections, LLC (1816 S Deshon Rd, Lithonia, GA — reply stop to opt out).
